rationale: The 27.47% gap with 71.8x relative volume is a significant move, but with no identifiable news catalyst it's impossible to assess whether the catalyst has legs or this is a purely speculative squeeze nearing exhaustion. The most recent candle showed a rejection from $14.31 back to $14.17 on shrinking volume, which could argue for a short fade, but the price remains near the 9-EMA and session VWAP is far below ($11.91), meaning a long still has structural support — the directional edge is ambiguous. Given the wide spread (42.3 bps), no news context, no historical analogs, and existing negative P&L for the day, the risk/reward does not justify a position in either direction.
